title: Rwanda single-origin landing funnel
goal: Design a beautiful luxurious landing page funnel system for Lava Bean Single Origin, washed, arabica coffee from Rwanda.

phases.name: Build funnel pages
phases.done_when: funnel pages exist and add no brand-check violations (AdLibraryDashboard.vue raw colours pre-date this work)
phases.check: test -f pages/rwanda/index.vue && test -f pages/rwanda/select.vue && test -f components/FunnelSteps.vue && ! (pnpm -s brand:check 2>&1 | grep -v AdLibraryDashboard | grep -q FAIL)

phases.name: Tests and build
phases.done_when: unit tests and production build pass
